- **Step 5**: FINDING_6 (security): `scripts/ship-pr.sh` `run_rebase_rebump` performs `git add -u` on all tracked dirty paths before rebase, which can permanently record unintended WIP (including credentials/tokens left modified during a run) on the PR branch. Suggested fix: restrict staging to an allowlist (e.g. `larch-logs/`) or fail closed when residue is not from known hook paths. Routed to SECURITY.md private disclosure — NOT folded inline, NOT filed as OOS per security routing policy.
